posts.name: R N Pranav
posts.cooked:
I had a lot of network issues and hence vm access was disturbed. As a result, I was unable to do well,
Can I take up the ReOppe on 14th December ?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: You can only re-do if you fail this time.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: None from your side, if you fail it’ll be automatically assigned

posts.name: Abhishek Ramesh Kumar
posts.cooked: I had the same problem. My VM hanged right after some “space issue is fixed” announcement. It told me “Error. Can’t edit: permission denied.” And the proctor told me I was the only one facing it.

posts.name: ASWATHI G
posts.cooked: I couldn’t write the test as I had my semester exam on the same day. And couldn’t join on time. Will I be assigned to 14th December as well?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: If you had mailed us regarding this with adequate proof earlier, it may have been possible to reschedule you to the next slot. However, people absent in first slot are not eligible for rescheduling.

posts.name: Usha
posts.cooked: there was a script.swap file automatically created in my vm during exam. How to handle such things,? I have no clue. It was not allowing me save the script with , or open the script without a warning msg. I tried to delete the swap file . Can u pls make a video regarding this type of issues

posts.name: ASWATHI G
posts.cooked:
The exam details were posted only 2 days before my semester exams started. So I didn’t know about the exam earlier. Is it okay if I can send the proof now? Kindly reconsider for rescheduling as this score is needed for getting final grade.
Thank you.

posts.name: Chelluri Bharathi
posts.cooked: It is a issue from VM. Even I faced the same during exam and it was resolved after some time. some time got wasted because of this. I informed proctor about it during the exam. Also some others complained about the same.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: It is how vim works, if your session terminates without saving, a copy is saved. The instructions printed on the screen are pretty clear about how to proceed. You can either restore it, or delete the swap file, by pressing the appropriate key shown.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: It was mentioned from the start of term in the grading document

posts.name: Usha
posts.cooked: I did that , restore or delete, but it was temporary until u r working on the script, once u exit and want to edit the script again the message is displayed. Anyways, it was resolved after sometime after that space issue got fixed .
